page: UpCloud PREMIUM-4xCPU-8GB is a compute-oriented virtual server running on the KVM hypervisor. It is provisioned with 4 shared vCPUs derived from an AMD EPYC 9575F x86_64 processor clocked at 2.0 GHz, alongside 8.0 GB of memory (2.0 GB per vCPU). The underlying processor features 16 MB of L3 cache, 0.5 MB of L2 cache, and 64 KB of L1d cache, with instruction set support including AVX-512 extensions (AVX-512F, VNNI, BF16) and cryptographic acceleration such as AES, VAES, and SHA-NI. The instance includes 100 GB of local SSD storage, 1 complimentary public IPv4 address, and operates without discrete GPU accelerators.

Benchmark results demonstrate exceptional single-threaded performance. The AMD EPYC architecture delivers top-tier results in single-core stress-ng tests (3,870.68) and Geekbench single-core evaluations (2,220.0), alongside top-tier outcomes in single-threaded gzip compression (37.98 GB/sec), bzip3 decompression (17.23 GB/sec), and text processing tasks. However, multi-core metrics settle into the middle 50% category, with Geekbench multi-core scoring 6,652.0 and PassMark CPU reaching 11,887.95, reflecting its moderate 4-core physical footprint and shared CPU allocation.

Memory-intensive benchmarks highlight notable constraints. Although uncached large-block read operations register 92.2 GB/sec and write operations attain 34.28 GB/sec, overall memory performance ranks in the bottom 25% on the PassMark memory suite (1,532.04). Prompt processing throughput for a 7B LLM is correspondingly limited to 21.23 tokens/sec. Conversely, operational storage and network-adjacent benchmarks show steady middle-tier competence, generating 7.6 million Redis SET operations per second and 14.0 GB/sec static web serving throughput.

This server provides strong per-core computational speed for applications that rely on low-latency single-thread execution rather than expansive parallel memory. Best-fit use cases include API servers, build automation, CI/CD runners, lightweight text processing services, and general web applications that operate comfortably within an 8 GB RAM boundary.
description: UpCloud PREMIUM-4xCPU-8GB is a virtual server powered by KVM and an AMD EPYC 9575F processor running on the x86_64 architecture. It features 4 shared vCPUs at 2.0 GHz, 8.0 GB of RAM (2.0 GB per core), 100 GB of local SSD storage, and no GPU hardware. The instance exhibits top-tier single-threaded compute and compression speeds, led by a 2,220.0 single-core Geekbench score and 37.98 GB/sec gzip compression rate. Multi-core performance and web throughput align with mid-tier averages, including 7.6 million Redis SET operations per second, though overall memory benchmark scores sit in the bottom quartile. With its 1:2 vCPU-to-memory allocation, this configuration fits single-thread-intensive workloads such as CI/CD pipelines, compilation tasks, API endpoints, and web applications that do not demand extensive RAM capacities.
